summary: Blue Acquisition Corp (a Cayman blank-check company) filed an 8-K/A to correct an exhibit to its original report regarding a Business Combination Agreement (BCA) with Blockfusion Digital Infrastructure. The BCA, as amended, contemplates Blue and Blockfusion becoming wholly-owned subsidiaries of a new publicly traded company (Pubco). The Third Amendment added an earnout provision for up to 9,250,000 Pubco shares to certain Blockfusion stockholders based on performance. The filing is a routine correction; the core event is the ongoing SPAC merger. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory clearance timeline.
